newsitem.title: UK: BoE Governor to face Treasury committee on July 30.
newsitem.headline: BoE Governor to face Treasury committee on July 30.

text.p: Bank of England Governor Eddie George will testify to parliament's Treasury Select Committee on Wednesday, July 30, a Bank of England spokesman said on Tuesday.
The nominees for the new Committee were unveiled on Tuesday and will comprise seven Labour MPs, four Conservatives and a Liberal Democrat.

It has not yet been established when Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown will face the committee over his first budget, although the Daily Telegraph reported that he will be summoned to appear next week.
The Bank's monetary policy committee raised base rates by a quarter-point to 6.75 percent last week, the third such move since Labour secured a landslide election victory on May 1.
